name: Melia Keys In... Quantum Decade
source:
Let's see... *ahem* 

"I, Kelsey Burton, am on a mission to finally grow up and forget my embarrassing adolescent alter-ego - but it's gonna be tough while still navigating friendships with clueless childhood pals & a goofy alien fangirling over my old made-up persona." 

...

...Hey now, I take offense to this. I [i]am[/i] grown up - and what is this about a made-up alter ego? I have no idea what that's talking about...

Should I just keep reading off? Alright.

[From [url=https://littlenousstudio.itch.io/quantumdecade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
让我们看看…*咳咳* 

“我，凯尔西·伯顿，的使命是最终长大并忘记我尴尬的青春期另一个自我——但这会很艰难，同时还要与无知的儿时伙伴和一个对我旧的虚构角色迷恋的傻乎乎的外星人进行友谊。” 

…

…嘿现在，我对此感到生气。我[i]am[/i]长大了——这又是一个虚构的另一个自我吗？我不知道那在说什么…

我应该继续读下去吗？好吧。

[来自[url=https://littlenousstudio.itch.io/quantumdecade]Itch.io[/url]]
